lib.droppedTitle: Tooltip on the number of spectra discarded from a library, by reason.
lib.folder.native: Line of the Libraries window in the desktop app; {name} = path of the libraries folder.
lib.folder.fs: Line of the Libraries window when the user has chosen a folder on the computer; {name} = folder name.
lib.folder.error: Error next to the libraries folder; {name} = technical name of the browser error.
lib.st.newer: Next to the «Update available» status; {v} = newest version of the package.
lib.avail.progress: Progress of the download of a library package; {name} = package name, {piece}/{pieces} = current and total piece, {mb}/{total} = megabytes downloaded and total (already formatted).
lib.avail.done: Outcome of a library download; {n} = packages downloaded and verified.
lib.avail.job: Title of the progress panel while the chosen library packages are downloading.
lib.dl.err.http: Download error: HTTP response from the server; {status} = code (e.g. 404).
lib.dl.err.hash: Download error: a piece or the whole file does not have the expected SHA-256 fingerprint; {what} = which one.
lib.dl.err.version: Download error: the package is in a newer format than the program reads; {id} = package.
lib.dl.err.catalog: Download error: the package list is not valid; {detail} = technical detail.
lib.dl.err.io: Download error: writing to the libraries folder; {detail} = technical detail.
lib.dl.err.host: Download error: address not in the list of allowed sites; {detail} = address.
lib.readN: Progress of reading a library; {n} = spectra already read.
lib.xlsx.suffix: Final part of the downloaded file name; lowercase letters only, no accents.
lib.all.xlsxPrefix: Start of the downloaded file name; lowercase letters only, no accents.
lib.all.summary: Summary line; {q} = scans compared, {g} = peaks grouped, {r} = rows shown.
lib.err.corrupt: {what} = damaged part of the file (English technical word: truncated, crc, directory...).
lib.err.version: {found} = file format version, {need} = minimum version required.
lib.all.comparingN: Progress of the comparison with the libraries; {i} = spectra already compared, {n} = total.
lib.all.readingN: Progress of reading the file's MS2; {i} = scans read, {n} = total.
lib.all.showAll: Checkbox under «Identify all MS2»; {n} = total number of grouped peaks.
lib.all.shownVal: Value of the «Parameters» sheet of the Excel file: rows shown out of total; {n} = shown, {total} = total.
lib.all.sub: Line under the title of «Identify all MS2»; {ppm} = precursor tolerance.
lib.an.shifted: Cell of the analogs table: matched peaks and, among them, those matched after shifting the precursor.
lib.copied: Message after copying the table to the clipboard; {n} = number of rows.
lib.doneN: Outcome of reading a library; {n} = spectra read (already formatted).
lib.droppedN: Continuation of lib.doneN: spectra discarded; {n} = how many (already formatted).
lib.cutN: Continuation of lib.doneN: spectra kept with only their first peaks (engine cap); {n} = how many, {max} = peak cap per spectrum (already formatted).
lib.noPrec: Message when no entry has a precursor within the tolerance; {tol} = tolerance with unit (e.g. «10 ppm»).
lib.pairs.title: Caption of the table of matching peaks under the mirror plot; {n} = number of pairs.
lib.plot.shared: Label at the top right of the mirror plot; {n} = number of peaks in common.
lw.best: Title of the «What is it?» result; {name} = name of the best candidate (HTML in bold).
lw.hover.exp: Label on hovering an experimental peak of the mirror plot; {mz} = m/z, {it} = relative intensity in %.
lw.hover.lib: Label on hovering a library peak of the mirror plot; {mz} = m/z, {it} = relative intensity in %.
lw.hover.pair: Continuation of the peak label: the peak paired on the other side; {mz} = its m/z, {d} = signed difference.
lw.mol.aria: Accessible label of the structure drawing; {name} = candidate name.
lw.th.aria: Accessible label of the button that enlarges the structure thumbnail of a row; {name} = candidate name.
lw.th.bigAria: Accessible label of the enlarged structure; {name} = candidate name.
lw.sort: Tooltip of a sortable header; {col} = column name.
lib.results: Message after the search; {n} = results, {ms} = milliseconds.
lib.space: Line at the bottom of the libraries window; {mb} = megabytes used by the site.
lib.what.group: Note under a result entry; {n} = number of other entries with the same first block of the InChIKey (same flat structure, stereoisomers).
lib.what.nl: Under the mirror plot; {list} = masses of the common neutral losses, already formatted.
lib.what.cosVis: Additional evidence: {lo} = lower limit of the file's MS2 scan window, {cos} = cosine already formatted.
lib.what.attr: Under the mirror plot; authors, accession and license of the library entry (texts from the library files).
